material.description: User report: after Fill with bots and Start match, the GUI (the Hero select modal) is not removed. Path: scenarios/moba/panels.lua lobby_act start (around line 726-730) sets L.started and emits lobby_started_event; ui_call skips lobby_seats_event for start; the next refresh (game.timer panels, REFRESH_TICKS) calls emit_all, which emits the lobby modal as lobby_tree() = nil, so emit() should send a widget remove. Trace which link breaks: (1) the refresh timer still runs after started (check game.timer or any early return in refresh/emit_all); (2) update_heroes or another emit in emit_all raises before the lobby emit (HEROES reset at start); (3) the client's handling of the widget remove for the lobby modal (js/client/modui.js or widgets.js, and play.js where kind lobby with started is handled: onLobbyStart) does not hide the modal. Fix at the broken link. Acceptance: after Start match the hero-select modal is gone within one refresh; no regression in the lobby before the start; CI green on ci and pages. The visual check is a browser look (left to the browser lane). Ownership: whichever file carries the broken link (panels.lua, modui.js, widgets.js or play.js; report which).

material.subject: After filling bots and starting the match, the lobby hero-select GUI stays on screen
material.witness: Fix: js/client/play.js onLobbyStart now calls endLobby() after applyStart (mirrors the network START path). Pushed 65f95e601d223eb5410498e141f7e872b469bf57 (publish dispatch 1792927966082). Witness 1792928114949-5518-4bafb3754784cf: exit 0, RESULT: PASS (the pushed play.js has the call on the host start path). CI on 65f95e60: ci 2/2 success, pages 4/4 success (run 40189322320). Broken link: link (3), the host's local start path; links (1) refresh timer and (2) emit_all ordering read clean in source (lobby_tree() returns nil once started, so emit() sends the widget remove each refresh), not run live. Visual check (hero-select modal gone after Start match) is NOT done here: left to the browser lane. Browser verbs not used.
